screens.name: Home — default, omen success, omen unavailable, enlarged

screens.name: Home — expanded daily-omen policy

screens.name: Approach — normal, enlarged, focused and pressed

screens.name: Age confirmation

screens.name: Onboarding — optional birthday

screens.name: Age blocked — onboarding and birthday-edit variants

screens.name: Onboarding — birthday correction
screens.evidence: Sheets 39–40 show the correction form and return action, with the enlarged return label continuing below the captured viewport.

screens.name: Onboarding — focus unselected and optional-focus variant
screens.evidence: Sheets 2 and 40–41 show four parchment themes and Skip focus at both scales.

screens.name: Onboarding — focus selected
screens.evidence: Sheets 40–41 show a check beside Learning & growth and the primary action changing to Continue.

screens.name: Birthday editing — populated
screens.evidence: Sheet 72 shows populated date fields, Save, Cancel and Remove; supplied runtime reports cancellation and persistence checks.

screens.name: Birthday editing — partial and invalid

screens.name: Birth time — initial and optional

screens.name: Birth time — invalid

screens.name: Birth details — forgotten

screens.name: Birth city — empty and retained draft
screens.evidence: Sheets 6–7 and 70–71 show empty and Copenhagen-filled fields, disabled/enabled search and optional Skip.

screens.name: Birth city — service failure and no results

screens.name: Birth city — live results

screens.name: Birth profile — saved and recovered success

screens.name: Question — populated self and named-person variants

screens.name: Question — expanded context disclosure

screens.name: Named-person selection — populated, corrected and empty

screens.name: Question and custom answer — constrained populated forms

screens.name: Follow-up card 1 — unselected

screens.name: Follow-up card 2 — unselected and selected

components.name: Plan option

components.name: Share preview

components.name: Focus selection

components.name: Birth-profile surface

components.name: Birth-details form
components.evidence: Sheets 7–10 and 70–71 cover optional entry, format errors, search results, service failure and saved-data handling.

components.name: Named-person control
components.evidence: Sheets 5–6, 21–22 and 32 show recipient selection, labeled first-name entry and explicit empty-name guidance.

components.name: Evidence disclosure
components.evidence: Sheets 26–29 and 52–54 show labeled disclosure rows, chevrons, open content and return routes with reported full-text browser checks.

components.name: Export status
components.evidence: Sheets 60–61 distinguish preparation, download initiation and failure, supported by supplied actual-download and retry evidence.

components.name: Check-in outcome control
components.evidence: Sheets 15–17 and 45–48 and 55–56 distinguish unselected, unsaved, saved and canceled outcomes with reported reload verification.

components.name: Close and Back controls
components.evidence: Sheets 19–20 show focused Close and Back controls, and supplied runtime reports at least 44×44 targets with keyboard outlines.
findings: Preserve these visible focus frames consistently across all modal and reading-flow headers.

components.name: Parchment information cards
components.evidence: The sheets show hand-cut edges and contact shadows, while supplied measurements confirm additional shadow pixels without changing card bounds.
findings: Vary contact and edge shading subtly for very tall sheets so they retain physical depth instead of reading as stretched bordered panels.

components.name: Share feedback modal and URL inset
components.evidence: Sheets 58–67 show anchored exit actions, visible status and the scrollable fallback URL field across three widths.
findings: Strengthen the inset’s scrolling cue and shorten its preceding copy so the URL and Done remain easier to understand together.

limitations: All scores are provisional browser judgments based on the attached screenshots, chronological still-frame filmstrips and supplied runtime account; no independent browser execution occurred in this evaluation.
Corresponding normal, enlarged and transition captures are grouped with their settled screen; repeated fixtures are not counted as independent functional proof.
The supplied browser tests support behavior only within their stated coverage; screenshots alone do not establish activation, persistence, focus movement or successful network operations.

Physical iPhone, VoiceOver, native keyboard, tilt, haptics, actual OS sharing and native performance remain deferred; no deduction was applied solely for those boundaries and no full/native 9–10 certification is given.
Billing and navigator.share are simulated, connected Circles behavior is not demonstrated, and fixture predictions provide no evidence of model quality.
The filmstrips demonstrate sampled visual continuity, not video playback or frame rate; performance judgments rely on the separately supplied timing measurements.
The captures show painted room destinations and stable foreground geometry but do not independently establish the provenance or motion behavior of every painted layer.

Some screenshots begin at scrolled positions or depict deliberately constrained viewports; offscreen content was not classified as unreachable where supplied browser evidence reports successful retrieval.
No hard-gate failure is established by this evidence, but the authorized per-screen and per-component A>=9 and F>=9 threshold is not met.
topFixes: Improve dense centered explanations: quieter publisher metadata, shorter passage groups and clearer separation between semantic sections.
Reduce enlarged disclosure, profile and policy spacing so users retain task context and discover actions with less scrolling.
Make scrolling inside long writing fields and fallback URL fields visually explicit.
Strengthen pressed feedback and distinguish wood disclosure rows from primary commitment buttons.
Refine room crossfades to reduce doubled architecture, and integrate the Sky selector and golden orb ring more convincingly with the painted scene.
